issues: Document has no ТР ТС section headings anywhere (only address/location full-width rows and GOST-standard citations), so tr_section is null on every row per instructions (addresses/other non-TR-TS headings must not be substituted). Table numbering has anomalies preserved as-is: row 25 appears twice in a row (ГОСТ Р 55182 п.4.2.3.9 and п.4.2.3.10, likely the second should be 26) and row 281 is missing entirely (jumps from 280 to 282); these are transcribed exactly as printed, not corrected. Many rows in this document present ONE indicator applying to a long list of different object types (sharing the same norm_doc/indicator/range but different OKPD2/TNVED codes), rather than one row per object per indicator combination; these were expanded into one JSON row per (object, indicator) pair, repeating norm_doc/indicator/range as printed for each object, per the task's general repetition rule. Several indicator cells contain two different range/unit formats stacked in one cell (e.g. a numeric range plus a pass/fail phrase); these were preserved verbatim, semicolon-joined, in range_from rather than split or guessed, to avoid inventing which value belongs where. A few page-break/cell-alignment points (e.g. page 45 row 297 second indicator's range value; page 46-47 rows around ГОСТ 34656/34657) had ambiguous object-to-indicator alignment across cropped table cells; best-effort alignment was made based on visual proximity without fabricating values, and in a couple of spots a range value was inferred by carrying forward the nearest value shown above when the cell for that specific line appeared visually blank on the page. All pages (1-53) were visually read; title/signature content and address heading rows carried no table data (kept as non-tr_section context). Document covers three additional testing site addresses shown as full-width divider rows (ул. Малая Калужская, ул. Веры Белик, Италия locations) — none of these were used as tr_section values.
